findings.body:
The change swaps the two balance updates in the public transfer function. The base code debited `from` and credited `to`. At head, line 6 debits `to` and line 7 credits `from`, so every call moves the amount in the opposite direction from the documented contract that `from` pays `to`.

Trigger: Any call to `transfer(from, to, amount)` with a positive amount.</br>

Impact: Any caller of the public `transfer` gets balances moved backwards: the payer's balance grows and the payee's shrinks. This is a money-movement regression. No callers or tests are in this repository, so the impact depends on external users of the crate.
findings.suggestion: Restore the base order: `from.balance -= amount;` then `to.balance += amount;`.
findings.title: transfer debits the receiver and credits the sender

risk_level.reason: The diff reverses the transfer direction: the amount is now subtracted from the recipient and added to the sender, so every transfer moves money the wrong way while the commit message only says 'Reorder transfer updates'.
